title: Sharing an EPUB starts a chooser without FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK from an application context
reasoning: The injected context is the application context, so the Intent passed to startActivity must carry FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK. The code adds that flag to the nested ACTION_SEND intent, but startActivity receives the chooser intent returned by Intent.createChooser, which is a separate Intent. On devices that enforce this, sharing an existing EPUB throws and falls into the generic failure path instead of opening the share sheet.
reproduction: Call shareDigest with an existing EPUB while HistoryViewModel is using the injected application context. The chooser intent lacks FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK, so startActivity can throw AndroidRuntimeException and set the UI error to a generic share failure.
recommendation: Create the chooser first, add FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK to the chooser intent, and preserve URI grant flags on the chooser as needed before calling context.startActivity.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No HistoryViewModel tests were found, and existing tests do not exercise external share intents from an application context.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a HistoryViewModel test with a fake Context that records the exact Intent passed to startActivity and assert shareDigest starts a chooser Intent containing FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK and the expected stream grant.
